title: Improved constants in the H2 estimate for the Langevin dynamics: C = 2 and logarithmic dimension scaling of C'

standard_prerequisites.name: The standing Langevin setting of Section 3.1: D the position space with the potential V, beta the inverse temperature, nu the Gibbs measure e^{-beta V} dq / Z on D, and the Langevin generator with its symmetric and antisymmetric parts
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: the Section 3 opening prose around source lines 560-580, outside the counted spans
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes D, beta, V and nu in the counted statement and proof; the prose also fixes the notations ||nabla_q u||_{L^2(nu)} and nabla_q^* used throughout.

standard_prerequisites.name: The two matrix/vector norms used by the Hessian growth condition: for M in R^{d x d} the operator norm ||M||_{B(l^2)} = sup_{|xi| <= 1} |M xi|, and the l^inf norm |xi|_inf = max(|xi_1|, ..., |xi_d|)
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: source lines 893-897, outside the counted spans (the prose also cites Ledoux [Led99] for LSI background and is therefore not delivered as a context span)
standard_prerequisites.use: Defines the norms appearing in the numbered assumption equation eq:condition_Hessian_LSI of the counted statement.

core_obligations: Replace the Bochner Cauchy-Schwarz step: under the Hessian growth assumption eq:condition_Hessian_LSI, the bound eq:Bochnereq_CS is replaced by ||nabla_q^2 u||^2 <= ||nabla_q^* nabla_q u||^2 + c_3 ||nabla_q u||^2 + c_3 integral |nabla_q u|^2 |nabla V|_inf d nu (proof lines 913-916).

Control the last term by entropy, not by Lemma lem:VillaniA24: apply the classical entropy inequality integral f^2 g d nu <= Ent_nu(f^2) + ||f||^2 log integral e^g d nu, itself an immediate consequence of the Legendre duality between the entropy and the log-Laplace functional (proof lines 917-924).

Split the c-weighted bound: integral |nabla_q u|^2 |nabla V|_inf d nu <= (1/c) Ent_nu(|nabla_q u|^2) + (1/c) ||nabla_q u||^2 log integral e^{c |nabla V|_inf} d nu; the entropy factor is controlled by C_LSI ||nabla^2_q u||^2 using |nabla |nabla f||^2 <= |nabla^2 f|^2 (proof lines 925-929).
Bound the dimension factor: log integral e^{c |nabla V|_inf} d nu <= log d + log max_i integral e^{c |partial_{q_i} V|} d nu (proof lines 930-932).

Assemble and conclude: take c = eps^{-1} c_3 C_LSI to reach ||nabla^2 u||^2 <= (1/(1-eps)) ||nabla_q^* nabla_q u||^2 + L'_{d,eps} ||nabla_q u||^2 with the explicit L'_{d,eps}, set eps = 1/2, and follow the end of the proof of Proposition prop:estimate_cLa^2_invBBstar to close (proof lines 933-946).
proof_roadmap: Derive the sharper quadratic-variation bound replacing eq:Bochnereq_CS under the Hessian growth condition (proof lines 913-916).
State and justify the entropy inequality through Legendre duality (proof lines 917-924).
Split the weighted term into an LSI-controlled entropy factor and a dimension factor (proof lines 925-932).
Optimize c = eps^{-1} c_3 C_LSI, exhibit L'_{d,eps}, set eps = 1/2, and delegate the final assembly to the proof end of Proposition 3.5 (proof lines 933-946).
difficulty_reason: 912-946以熵对偶和LSI控制Bochner余项，改用最大梯度指数积分把维度因子压成log d，并优化自由常数。它提供一般resolvent界没有的维度改进，保留独立目标；常规Villani/高斯系数/H2控制链保留为支撑。
